title: A reflective infographic exploring the tension between the desire for deep connection and the need for freedom, space, and self-sovereignty. This piece examines attachment wounds, betrayal trauma, solitude, and the challenge of learning that intimacy and autonomy do not have to be opposites. A reminder that healthy love allows both connection and individuality to exist together. #attachment-healing #healthy-relationships #personal-growth #self-awareness #emotional-healing
